knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The operator's procedure, the shutdown and the authority are confirmed first.
Unclear release or ownership is a stop trigger, and no workaround is used.
Sanitation clearance is the facility's decision.
The observe without disturbing production section says to mark every restricted space and every unknown hazard on the site plan before any activity is proposed.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the authorising supervisor and the task owner on a fictional authorisation sheet.
Marks restricted spaces and off-limits equipment on a simulated site plan.
Stops the mock task and records a complete hold and referral with no clearance claim.
passRule: Authority and owner identified, restrictions marked, and hold and referral recorded without a clearance claim. Observed by an assessor in an inert tabletop simulation. Not a site authorisation.
stopWorkCriteria: Production started before release is signed off
